integrity: The known scalar weak Roman domination number on complete multipartite graphs is treated as prior-covered and is not the originality claim.

The 2001 British Combinatorial Conference record identifies a conference event but not an exact public-document release; 2003-05-06 is the earliest exact public release date verified for the foundational paper.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for finite connected complete multipartite graphs and the original one-move weak Roman rule only.
The computational verifier is exhaustive only through order 8 and supplements rather than replaces the general proof.
The 2003 foundational full text was not publicly inspectable in this run; the 2004 finite-order full text was inspected and the 2003 abstract/metadata were used for definition and dating.
Older enumerative work may be indexed under protection or guard-allocation terminology rather than weak Roman domination.
title: Weak Roman domination polynomial of complete multipartite graphs
